findings.rule: spec.md Design § Dependencies and CI (CI installs polars, pinned); intent Affected systems (CI must install the project)
findings.summary: The project CI still installs only pytest and ruff, so once this change merges `python -m pytest` fails while collecting tests/test_data.py (`import polars`) on every push to main and every PR; plan.md records the departure, but the spec requirement is unmet and CI goes red.

findings.rule: REVIEW.md Framework rules: flag when the change has made CLAUDE.md outdated
findings.summary: The change makes CLAUDE.md outdated: it still calls the project a package skeleton with one smoke test, gives `python -m pip install pytest ruff` (no polars, 'declares no extras') as setup, and `1 passed` as the healthy test output (now 69 passed); the run cannot edit it, so the owner needs to update it in their own PR.

findings.rule: security-baseline rule 7 as applied in spec.md (runtime calls only the three Binance hosts); R12 timeouts
findings.summary: build_opener keeps the default redirect handler and plain-HTTP handler, so a 3xx from a Binance host would be followed to any host, including over http:// with no timeout. That breaks the 'only the three Binance hosts' and 10 s/60 s timeout assumptions. It is unlikely in practice (doubt: Binance does not redirect these paths today).

findings.rule: spec.md Design § Parameters (validated before any URL or path is built)
findings.summary: parse_date returns a `datetime` unchanged because datetime is a subclass of date, so `load_klines(..., start=datetime(...))` raises a bare TypeError from `end_day > today` (datetime vs date) instead of InvalidRequestError or a normalised `.date()`.
